body:
Well to start let me say that I should have planned out my day before I did nutmeg. Also the preground nutmeg does not work I've tried it only the whole nutmeg (the seeds) work. Well I've heard of nutmeg from a friend who said he tried it and it was awesome. When he told me this I thought it was to good to be true. Let me say I tried the preground nutmeg number of time and nothing ever happened. So I was beggining to give up on nutmeg. Then 2 weeks later I read that only the whole nutmeg works because thay take out the chemical that makes you trip in preground. So as a last attempt I decide to go buy some whole nutmeg. I bought 2 packs of 14 gram nutmeg and grounded one pack and half of the other. Then I decided to drink it down with some water and let me say that it tasted aweful. This was around 9 pm. So I decide to go to sleep cause my friend said its awesome to wake up to.
I wake up around 5 am like usual to get ready for school. As I wake up everything is the same as usual and I was like what a waste. So as I get out of bed everything felt weird. I felt super stone and I was like I didnt smoke last night did I? So as I'm walking to the bathroom to brush my teeth the room starts to spin and I cant walk straight and I kept bumping into the wall and my mom who was sleeping was yelling at me for making so much noise. As I finally make it to the bathroom I start to brush my teeth but as I'm brushing my teeth something weird happens. My leg bends and I zoom in on the sink and then I zoom out. Its hard to explain but this happens for a while until I leave the bathroom.
I walk to my room and when I get to my room my upper body starts to move on its on accord like when I'm high on salvia. Its starts to go back and forth on its own and picks up speed. At the time I was thinking I'm either being possessed by some spirit or this is some strong nutmeg. Either way it was fun and I started to laugh then everything stopped. I didnt feel high anymore I felt normal. I was kind of sad cause it finished way to quick and I though I must have slept through most of it last night. So I put on my school cloths and got ready for another boring day of high school.
So I go downstairs and walk around downstairs like usual waiting for the bus to come. As I'm walking around my eyes start to feel weird. They feel like they have electricity in them and someone is trying to suck them out with a plunger and then the feeling starts to get really intense ( but for some reason it felt awesome) and then it finally happens, I trip out. Even though wikipedia classifies this as a deliriant I classify it as a dissociative because it felt the day I tripped on salvia. I was inside my head where the brain was but my brain was super small and there was robotic looking bugs in my head then everything zooms out of my eyes and it feels like I'm watching tv. The background is like a barnyard but sketch in crayon and theres two people arguing. One of the person is Hannah montanas dad ( I know weird right) and the other is my friend CJ. CJ is yelling at Hannahs dad saying get your guitar out of my house and Hannahs dad yells back well get your house out of my guitar It was the most stupidest thing I have ever seen but for some reason it was the most funniest thing I have ever seen it was weird. And then everything goes haywire. Its like someone is flipping through the channels really fast and then it ends with a cartoon version of me lost in the tv laughing. But the most weirdest part was my eyes. It was just psychedelic colors and thing everything got sucked away and I was back in reality just laughing like a retard. I stopped laughing and was confused. I had no idea how much time went by and didnt know how I ended up in the kitchen. I just felt stone and this intense euphoria like on extasy. Then my bus came and while I was sitting on the bus my memory came back and I remember the trip. I remember was that me daydreaming? But then quickly discovered I dont daydream so it must have been a trip like salvia. Well the whole day I felt stoned and I liked it. I still do nutmeg once in a while and I love it. I think everyone should try this drug. Its so unique.
